verification.scope: Independent reconstruction of membership, weighted means/variances, saved coefficients and rank metrics; same-library covariance/tangent rebuild; no clinical validation

limitations: Both cohorts repeatedly used in development; new supervised support adaptation, not new clinical confirmation.
Disease, scanner, source processing and sex composition differ; covariate fitting does not prove all confounding removed.
Emo user batch confirmation, not full expert visual review; 13 original failures excluded; four subjects have analysis-mask empty small regions in 419 atlas.
Conditional intervals reuse saved predictions, do not cover refitting, model selection, complete support-set distribution or multiplicity.
Dataset ID disjointness does not independently establish biological identity or pretraining-data non-overlap.
Joint sample weights sum to joint training size; tangent reference unweighted; changes can affect effective regularization and geometry.
conclusion: 每类5人的全部双向、两种适配模式没有同时支持预训练超过强FC和随机表示；不据局部优势宣称稳定迁移收益。
